Delhi High Court Restrains Misuse of Cricketer Yuvraj Singh's Identity

The Delhi High Court has issued an order restraining the misuse of cricketer Yuvraj Singh's identity, personality rights, and image. The court directed the removal of AI-generated deepfakes and unauthorized merchandise that falsely depict the cricketer in fabricated situations. The plea stated that several social media accounts had circulated such content. This ruling aims to protect Yuvraj Singh's rights against unauthorized commercial exploitation and the creation of misleading digital content.
